svg.title: Marquee Event Buy Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-marquee-event-buy-gates; chapter number: 5; chart type: decision_tree; title: Marquee Event Buy Gates; subtitle: Masters, UFC, CFP and tennis purchase checks; caption: Four gates separating Augusta's official-channel lockbox from the resale and premium hospitality market around other marquee events.; assumptions note: Gate thresholds follow practitioner testimony; stated Masters ballot odds range from under 1% to 3-5% depending on the source.; note: Sources: Gameday Guides (LtTBm2wHjoE @ 00:01:03 and 00:01:59), WTHR (OSa-CK_qebs @ 00:01:13 and 00:02:30), MMALeaked (2vauuB_YXFc @ 00:04:26), Sports Travel Tom (iKAz6YJRTXI @ 00:01:43).; nodes: gate: G1; question: If the event is the Masters, is the badge coming through the ballot with exactly one application per household?; pass next: G2; fail action: Stop: Augusta voids tickets at the gate with RFID tracking and permanently revokes lifetime badges; duplicate household entries get both disqualified.; gate: G2; question: Is the seller on a verified site, with proof of purchase kept?; pass next: G3; fail action: Refuse the deal and walk away from any seller who rushes you.; gate: G3; question: Is the price backed by completed sales rather than listed asks?; pass next: G4; fail action: Wait: 9 times out of 10 prices come down closer to the event, and most high asks never sell.; gate: G4; question: Has the sightline been checked before paying a premium?; pass next: Buy; fail action: Skip the seat: a $470 last-section UFC ticket put a metal pillar between the buyer and the cage.

circle.title: gate: G1; question: If the event is the Masters, is the badge coming through the ballot with exactly one application per household?; pass next: G2; fail action: Stop: Augusta voids tickets at the gate with RFID tracking and permanently revokes lifetime badges; duplicate household entries get both disqualified.
gate: G2; question: Is the seller on a verified site, with proof of purchase kept?; pass next: G3; fail action: Refuse the deal and walk away from any seller who rushes you.

gate: G3; question: Is the price backed by completed sales rather than listed asks?; pass next: G4; fail action: Wait: 9 times out of 10 prices come down closer to the event, and most high asks never sell.

gate: G4; question: Has the sightline been checked before paying a premium?; pass next: Buy; fail action: Skip the seat: a $470 last-section UFC ticket put a metal pillar between the buyer and the cage.

text.title: Assumptions: Gate thresholds follow practitioner testimony; stated Masters ballot odds range from under 1% to 3-5% depending on the source.
